HandyConnect - structure
  *.html        pages (structure only; content is generated by js)
  css/style.css styles
  js/data.js    EDIT HERE: artisans (P), métiers (C), gouvernorats (G), texts, FAQ, reviews
  js/app.js     rendering, language FR/AR, pages
  js/forms.js   ALL forms: rules in HTML attributes, actions in ACT, API='' = demo mode
  js/ai.js      assistant (set AI_ENDPOINT for a real AI)
  img/          logo.svg, logo-white.svg, artisan photos 1.jpg ... 15.jpg (optional)
Forms: every <form> has action + method="post" + data-form="name"; add a new form = add ACT.name in forms.js.
